statement: Each Vera Rubin NVL72 rack carries 20.7 TB of HBM4 memory, and a 16-rack Scalable Unit blueprint with 1,152 Rubin GPUs carries 331 TB of HBM4.
why: HBM content per rack sets how much of the world's high-bandwidth memory supply each unit of accelerator capacity consumes, and it is the tightest link in the chain.

impact.mechanism: Rising HBM4 content per shipped rack raises memory draw per deployed GPU, tightening HBM and advanced-packaging supply as Rubin volumes ramp.

evidence.excerpt: Each rack provides '20.7 TB of HBM4 memory' and 'up to 54 TB of LPDDR5X memory.'
1,152 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs' with '331 TB of HBM4 memory' across '16 compute racks

confidence.basis: Vendor specification sheet in a press release, secondary tier; no HBM supply or bit-growth data accompanies it.

dispersion: 20.7 TB HBM4 per rack; 331 TB across a 16-rack Scalable Unit.
